diagnosis.verified_defect: Rust Instant on Darwin excludes system sleep, but the C adapter translated its remaining budget to CLOCK_MONOTONIC, which includes sleep. A native exchange could expire while the Rust caller still had awake-time budget.
diagnosis.change: Use CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW for native deadlines, matching Rust Instant and Mach waits. Budget sizes, identity checks, session burning on actual expiry, and replay refusal are unchanged.
diagnosis.owner_causality: Confirmed sleep and 756ms owner-exchange timing are consistent with this reproduced defect. Physical Mac retest is still required.

validation.native_clock: Two Darwin C tests: independently advanced sleep-inclusive/awake clocks reproduce old-code failure and pass corrected code; genuine expiry, range bound and clock failure still refuse
validation.existing_profile_update: Six POSIX tests: preserve identity/events/old app; refuse wrong profile, active application, changed identity, replaced root, late process start and build failure
validation.native_channel: Signed subprocess supervisor suite passed (16 scenarios); two ignored driver entry points are invoked by the suite
validation.packet: Committed source packet build and exact member readback passed on Mac CI and locally
validation.not_tested: Physical machine sleep/wake and real Windows-Mac durable delivery
